transcript: Speaker A (AI Robot): Hello, what is your name? Speaker B (Kavita): My name is Kavita. Speaker A (AI Robot): Kavita, tell me about your work. Speaker B (Kavita): I am doing job in a company since two years. Speaker A (AI Robot): दो गलतियाँ एक लाइन में। 'Doing job' नहीं, 'I have been working at a company' होता है। और 'since two years' नहीं, 'for two years' होता है। [Two mistakes in one line. Not 'doing job', it is 'I have been working at a company'. And not 'since two years', it is 'for two years'.] Speaker B (Kavita): Oh. I have been working at a company for two years. Speaker A (AI Robot): Perfect. अब बताओ, कल ऑफिस में क्या हुआ? [Perfect. Now tell me, what happened in the office yesterday?] Speaker B (Kavita): Yesterday, my boss told me for complete the report. Speaker A (AI Robot): 'Told me for complete' नहीं होता, 'told me to complete' होता है। [It's not 'told me for complete', it's 'told me to complete'.] Speaker B (Kavita): यार, मुझे तो पता ही नहीं चलता कहाँ 'for' लगाना है, कहाँ 'to'. ऑफिस में ईमेल लिखती हूँ तो कलीग चेक करके देता है। बॉस ने डांटा, तबसे खुद ईमेल नहीं लिखती। [I don't know when to use 'for' or 'to'. Colleagues check my emails. My boss scolded me once, so I stopped writing them myself.] Speaker A (AI Robot): इसीलिए तो मैं हूँ। English Seekho ऐप पे एक्सपर्ट के छोटे-छोटे वीडियो हैं, हिंदी में समझाते हैं। और मैं हूँ AI कोच, 24 घंटे अवेलेबल। [That's why I'm here. English Seekho app has short expert videos in Hindi and a 24/7 AI coach.] Speaker B (Kavita): लेकिन ऑफिस से आके बहुत थक जाती हूँ, टाइम नहीं मिलता। [But I get too tired after office to find time.] Speaker A (AI Robot): रोज़ सिर्फ 15-20 मिनट। ट्रायल सिर्फ ₹1 का है। इंस्टॉल का बटन दबाओ और English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Just 15-20 minutes daily. The trial is only ₹1. Press install and download the English Seekho app.] Speaker C (Voiceover): तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: A woman named Kavita gets her English grammar corrected by an AI robot screen. The robot promotes the English Seekho app, highlighting its short Hindi-medium lessons, 24/7 AI practice, and a 1-rupee trial to help with office communication.
